subject: Cutover Surge-Control Sanity Blitz & KV Primer - Go/No-Go and Readout
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus CloudOps Network Team <netops@nimbusops.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover window confirmation - questions on surge controls

Mina —

Quick note from NetOps after reviewing the tentative window: our fabric team expects a short-lived control-plane surge during the first 12 minutes of the cutover when BGP flaps are reconciled. Can you confirm Redwood's automatic throttle/backoff policy for the first 15 minutes and whether you will enable the conservative KV primer to reduce token spikes?

Also looping in procurement for the PO hold release timing so we can schedule on our side.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Site Reliability Lead — Nimbus CloudOps

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>, Nimbus CloudOps Network Team <netops@nimbusops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover window confirmation - surge controls and KV primer plan

Alex / NetOps —

Good questions. Short answers:
- Redwood will enable the conservative surge-control profile for the first 20 minutes (throttle/concurrency floors configured).
- We'll run a KV primer (warmup) against the prefix set for 30 minutes leading into the window; this is the kv-warmup-plan attached.
- If we detect >15% token latency regression vs baseline in the first 10 minutes, we have an automatic fallback to the smaller model variant plus circuit-level backoff.

I'm attaching the latest runbook and the network diagram for DC3. Please review the KV prefix list (section 2 of kv-warmup-plan.md) and confirm any prefixes you want excluded.

I'll coordinate a short call with ops at T-2 hours to validate the primer and throttle parameters.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Principal Deployment Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_v5.pdf (application/pdf), network-diagram-dc3.png (image/png), kv-warmup-plan.md (text/markdown)

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover surge controls and KV primer plan — checklist items

Team —

I read the runbook. A few tactical asks before we kick off primer:
1) Confirm NTP sync window and when you will disable asymmetric routing detection (NetOps).
2) Please pre-seed the first 5000 prefixes in our cache simulator at T-30 so we don't see cold-path amplification. I left a small script (prep_prefix_seed.sh) in the Drive link.
3) Ops escalation matrix: make sure the on-call L2 for Redwood is reachable on the channel + phone number in the runbook. The phone fallback is critical for minute-0 incidents.

If NetOps signs off on (1) and (2) by EOD PST we can do a rehearsal on Sunday morning and then proceed with the primer Monday.

Karthik
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>

Subject: Re: Cutover surge controls and KV primer plan — NetOps sign-off

Mina / Karthik —

NetOps confirms: NTP sync will be revalidated at T-60 and asymmetric detection will be suspended for the T+20 window. We will exclude prefix 10.42.19.0/24 from the primer (customer-owned) — confirmed.

We can run the rehearsal at 09:30 PST Sunday; that works for our bridge. Procurement will release PO hold at 14:00 PST Monday.

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 16:05:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover surge controls and KV primer plan — rehearsal notes

Quick rehearsal notes from the morning run:
- KV primer ran for 22 minutes as planned (simulated load), memory profiles stable.
- We observed a transient 6% increase in median token latency on node pool b-east-3 during prefix seeding; throttles kicked in and latencies returned to baseline within 90s.
- BGP convergence was noisy for exactly 7 minutes; NetOps trace attached in the drive link.
- No failed automations; canary traffic showed correct fallback to model-v2-small when latency breached threshold.

Action items:
- Mina: bake updated throttle: reduce max-concurrency by 10% for first 12 minutes.
- Karthik: run the prefix seeding script at T-30 (confirm start).
- Alex/NetOps: confirm PO release path Monday 14:00 PST.

I'll stand up the activation bridge at 08:45 PST Monday and post a short readout 2 hours after activation.

Marissa Cole
Deployment Program Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@nimbusops.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Nov 2027 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: CUTOVER READOUT: Surge-control sanity blitz + KV primer — PASS (short summary)

Team —

Short readout from activation today (activation window 09:00 - 10:30 PST):
- Result: PASS (no service-impacting incidents).
- KV primer: ran T-30 -> T+10 (40 minutes total). Primer warmed ~7.2k prefixes listed in kv-warmup-plan.md.
- Latency: transient median token latency spike 8% at T+3m on pool b-east-3; automatic throttle reduced concurrency and fallback executed as designed. All latencies returned to baseline by T+5m.
- Model fallbacks: 3 requests hit the smaller model variant between T+3m and T+4m; this is within expected golden signals.
- Network: BGP converged in 6m 12s; NetOps trace attached to Drive link.
- Post-activation checks: health probes green for 120 consecutive minutes; no error-rate regression.

Attachments and links:
- Final runbook execution log: https://drive.redwood/release/D-48721/runbook_v5/logs
- NetOps trace: https://drive.redwood/release/D-48721/netops/bgp-trace
- KV primer results csv: https://drive.redwood/release/D-48721/kv/primer-results.csv

Open items:
- Follow-up: Karthik to validate cache hit-rate delta in full load test (INF-1129) by EOD Wednesday.
- Procurement: finalize invoice timing and confirm PO closure (Procurement cc'd).

Thanks everyone for the tight coordination. Closing this as a successful activation; I will upload the sanitized runbook and a condensed postmortem if anything looks off in the metrics review.

Mina Haddad
Principal Deployment Engineer — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128
